Attached: 1 image

Spent some time adding functionality to the Chart View.  

I have to be careful here for two reasons, number one because I'm not a believer in charting, and also there's many programs out there that draw better charts than I ever will.  

At the same time, a picture does paint a thousand words, and charts definitely provide value and are good at representing data.  

I am doing my best to present the data in a way that is usable and can be interpreted in order to make informed investing decisions.

The graph view supports the following time views - 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y.

In addition to the price history, the Chart View provides the following data points.

Price, 1D price change, YTD price change, 1Y (calendar) price change, 3Y (calendar) price change, 5Y (calendar) price change, Variance from 1 Year Best Fit Line, Variance from 3 Year Best Fit Line, Variance from 5 Year Best Fit Line, PE(TTM) - Price/Earnings Trailing Twelve Months, EBITDA

On the chart itself are represented the current price, the 30 day moving average, the to day moving average envelope and (if the timeline is large enough) the one year, three year and five year best fit lines.

More information is available on the online documentation.

https://red82.com/stocky/documentation#chart-view
